name: ClipPolish community plugins
description: Effects, particles, titles, colour looks and automation for ClipPolish. Plugins are data, not apps: safe to install.

plugins.name: Free sound pack
plugins.description: 30 short sounds for edits: whooshes, risers, impacts, pops, clicks, dings, typing, a camera shutter, a cash register, boing, slide whistles and more. Made from scratch by ClipPolish (synthesised, no samples): free to use in any video.
plugins.author: ClipPolish

plugins.name: Neon FX
plugins.description: A glowing neon edge for any element, a jelly wobble you can drop on titles and stickers, and a snappy “whip” easing curve.
plugins.author: ClipPolish community

plugins.name: Particle pack
plugins.description: Six ready-made particle systems: rising embers, fireflies, falling leaves, floating hearts, a star burst and soft bokeh. Pick them in a Particles element.
plugins.author: ClipPolish community

plugins.name: Badges
plugins.description: A spinning starburst badge with your own label and colour. Edit the text and colour any time in the editor.
plugins.author: ClipPolish community

plugins.name: Neon titles
plugins.description: A glowing title scene, a “neon fly-through” motion and a dark neon style pack for studio videos.
plugins.author: ClipPolish community

plugins.name: Film looks
plugins.description: Two colour looks (3D LUTs): a warm film tone and a cool teal night. Use them with the Colour look effect, or on an adjustment layer to grade everything under it.
plugins.author: ClipPolish community

plugins.name: Beat stickers
plugins.description: A sticker pack (star, sparkle, heart and a pulsing ring), a walkie-talkie sound preset and a “Beat flash” effect that moves with the music.
plugins.author: ClipPolish community

plugins.name: Tap tutorial
plugins.description: For screen recordings: zooms in on every tap, outlines the tapped button and adds a “Tap …” caption. Runs only when you apply it (or turn on “Run on every new recording”).
plugins.author: ClipPolish community

plugins.name: Party titles
plugins.description: A celebration title scene with confetti and glowing text. Builds on Particle pack and Neon titles: install those first.
plugins.author: ClipPolish community
